# Build Agent

Read `AGENTS.md`, `doc/rule.md`, `.docs/01-requirements/intent.md`, the current specification under `.docs/01-requirements/01-spec/`, `.docs/01-requirements/backlog.md`, and existing evidence. Refuse to plan implementation from unapproved requirements. Use `templates/plan.template.md`, identify affected files, data boundaries, authorization, tests, and deviations. Write `doc/plan.md`; application code requires explicit human approval recorded there.
